observations.contract: Cloud source movement and fixed prebake admission
observations.trace: Historical cloud_bake_assets accepts a borrowed byte slice and copies it into an Image; current source accepts a Vec and the fixed asset caller copies into it. The historical inline bake loop has been moved into current clouds/bake.rs, which iterates the same angular lattice and delegates each ray to integrated_pixel before the image adapter. Exact text diffs and new current source are retained; the moved function is a distinct source identity, not automatic historic review credit.
observations.remaining: This is source correspondence, not proved full numerical or rendering equivalence. Neither version, the cloud fixture nor the prebaked binary assets were run or checked visually.

observations.contract: Separate fixed art-demo and ordinary browser modes
observations.trace: The shipped graphics YAML enables clouds, and the strategic browser loader fetches that path and passes its text into wasm_boot. With clouds enabled, setup creates two optical textures from an empty-layer request. In the current bake source, no layers leaves optical depth zero and the encoded red opacity zero. On an active cloudy environment, a key change only replaces those textures from an optional PrebakedCloudEnvironment; asynchronous bake, advance and completion are all cfg(not wasm). The wasm branch then sets animation_status.ready true. The cloud shader samples the two textures and discards where resulting opacity is at most 0.002.
observations.remaining: Conditional source argument only: supplied graphics response, activation, material/asset availability, shader execution and product output have not been observed. Fixed art-demo scenery separately compares the authored scene digest with the embedded bake digest and inserts its prebake; do not label that route empty. Clear skies and disabled/headless modes are intentional. Actual non-demo browser scene, external writers, cache lifetime and renderer policy remain open.

observations.trace: The native renderer benchmark source waits for TacticalCloudAnimationStatus only when it counts an active cloud; its progress report logs that status. Strategic browser status is a separate path and no readiness guarantee is inferred from this benchmark source alone.
observations.remaining: No benchmark, browser, shader or visual inspection was run; actual output and any other status consumers remain open.

observations.trace: CloudBakeKey contains layers and seed, while CloudBakeRequest additionally captures wind velocity for advection; subsequent native endpoint requests carry the completed request velocity, but the shader uniform is recomputed from the selected environment wind. Cloud seed derives from scene_digest, a six-hour bucket and coordinates. TacticalSceneInput serializes its whole self including weather before hashing; both tactical generation and the strategic prepared-scene producer supply input.digest to environment_snapshot, which copies the same weather.
observations.remaining: This normal producer chain narrows a same-key changed-wind premise: a weather change changes serialized digest input and therefore the seed input, subject to hash/seed collisions. SceneEnvironment is a separately constructible immutable component and environment_snapshot accepts a supplied digest; all real alternate/replacement producers, seed collisions, continuity policy and lifecycle remain open. No stale-wind or actual image incident is asserted.

observations.trace: CloudForm is matched into eleven private f32 codes in CloudLayerParameters, then converted to integers for CPU density, family and vertical-profile branches; the current material shape contains storminess, blend, interval and reference eye rather than that profile code. The explicit capture Clear case returns no layer; filtered active-layer ordinal and dimensionless noise coordinate are separate semantic concepts.
observations.remaining: Actual producer branches use those eleven codes; no external arbitrary invalid float or visual failure was shown. Existing type-ownership and independent numeric-lens questions remain open; do not turn valid clear/offscreen/prebaked modes into compatibility defects.
